coordinateBoundary: Native LH metres to Web RH metres: [x,y,-z]. Model payloads preserve native origins; terrain rows reverse along Z. No scene-scale normalization.

vehicle.tireArgumentMeaning: SDK declaration unavailable; original argument order retained without asserting width/radius labels
vehicle.materialAdapter: Use intended body/glass/undercarriage bindings; the native LoadTextures call misorders its string arguments. BMP maps read top row first, with original TVM UVs unchanged.

terrain.note: Exact constant field compressed to2x2; extent interpreted from C++ fWidth*256, not image pixel count.

limitations: Opponent0 overlaps the player in source; any separation must be labelled as an adapter
CarsManager is used before initialization; native startup/network is not certified

terrain.note: Full512x512 DXT1 red-channel heights retained; row reversal is the coordinate boundary. Runtime mesh/collider sampling is an explicit resolution adapter.

experimentalWater.note: Shared water class places its plane485units above the terrain; preserve this source value and disclose any visibility/height adapter.

limitations: Opponents are commented out in this branch
Most authored rings lie beyond the terrain; no completed race/progression binding is established
Native water/render-surface and closed-engine tire fidelity are not certified

adapters: PBR/material response, web lighting and camera are current adapters
No native network client or historic executable is run
The modern oval/hillclimb and orphan cars are separate from these source worlds
